messages:
maya: Quick sync — customer A pushed a hard ask: eval-triggered alerts + per-route quantization recommendations + route-level batching presets. Can we realistically include all of that in the Optimize toolkit v1?
jon: short answer: not all. eval alerts + simple batching presets = doable. quant recs need model-side eval infra and quality guardrails.
lee: +1 to jon. propose MVP = 1) presets for batching (low/med/high) 2) prefix/KV caching toggle + TTL 3) eval-alert webhook for regression hits (threshold-based). leave automated quant recs for v2.
sam: customer A is pushing hard — they want ops automation for cost savings now. If we prioritize eval-alert webhooks + recommendations that point to a quant config (manual), they might accept.
karthik: rollout concerns: quant recommendations without automatic apply = safe. we can ship a UI card that says "recommended quant: int8 on fp16-model-x — expected 20% token cost reduction" but requires manual approve.
jon: technical checklist for v1: 
- batching presets (server-side continuous batching hooks)
- KV/prefix cache toggle + per-route TTL config
- eval-alerts pump to webhook + email + slack
- perf metrics per-route (p50/p95/p99)
All of these are small infra pieces except the metrics plumbing.
lee: launch criteria suggestions: 
- eval-alert false-positive rate < 5% on our internal evals
- p95 latency overhead due to batching < 10% vs baseline
- customer signoff on manual quant rec card wording
If those pass, go for GA.
maya: product tradeoffs: we keep scope tight to reduce risk. customers can opt into beta for quant recommendations (manual apply). we surface cost-econ numbers in the UI.
sam: sales note: if we can promise "manual quant recs" in beta + eval-alerts within 6 weeks, it buys time for full automation.
karthik: deployment plan: feature-flag everything, canary to 5% dedicated first, then 25% with rollback window. set hard SLO guardrails.
jon: quick config snippet for batching presets: 
```
batching_presets:
  low: max_batch_tokens: 1024, max_latency_ms: 20
  med: max_batch_tokens: 4096, max_latency_ms: 50
  high: max_batch_tokens: 16384, max_latency_ms: 200
```
lee: QA notes: include a prompt-set that exercises long-prefix KV cache + quant sim (simulate int8 by rounding). ensure eval-alerts trigger on regressed F1/drop > threshold.
maya: next steps: jon/lee scope infra work + rough ETA, karthik to draft canary rollout plan, sam to set expectation with customer. I'll consolidate acceptance criteria and send a PRD.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create feature flag for "optimize-toolkit-v1" when PRD hits repo. :robot_face:
